## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests
- [ ] Ran `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] Ran `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] Ran `uv run mypy`
- [ ] Ran `uv run pytest -W error::DeprecationWarning`
- [ ] Updated matching English and Chinese documentation when behavior changed

## Scope

- [ ] No dataset, model weight, generated artifact, or private path is included
- [ ] Tests remain offline and deterministic
